meaning: Android: occlusion counting: `2` (default) one query per stretch of counted draws in a pass, counting only from a reset to the report after it; `1` a query per draw, paired; `0` a query per draw from the first counter use on (as before vk19.44)

name: DM_VK_PASSLOG
meaning: Android: `=<frame>[+]` logs that frame's passes, draws, copies and dispatches (targets, clears, shaders, depth / stencil / blend)

name: DM_VK_PASS_BARRIER
meaning: Android: `1` leaves vertex shaders out of each pass end's barrier (the next pass's vertex work may overlap); a vertex shader that samples such a pass's target gets a barrier first. Default 0

name: DM_VK_PATCH_VERIFY
meaning: Android: `1` checks each compute stale patch (DM_VK_STALE_PATCH=2) word by word against the staged words when its submission completes, and logs the counts and the first mismatches

name: DM_VK_POOL_RESET
meaning: Android (vk19.64, off by default; read at start): `1` makes each submission's command pool with RESET_COMMAND_BUFFER_BIT and has dm-complete reset its two command buffers one by one instead of the pool (the pool when secondaries were used); the per-600 command-pool line times dm-complete's resets in every mode and counts resets left to the recording thread, with the context count

name: DM_VK_POOL_TRANSIENT
meaning: Android: `1` creates the command pools VK_COMMAND_POOL_CREATE_TRANSIENT_BIT, as before vk19.20 (default 0: kept warm, reset without releasing their memory)

name: DM_VK_PRESENT_PACE
meaning: Android (vk19.63, off by default until its A/B; read at start only): the first swapchain asks the window for the frame cap (DM_FPS: 60, or 30 for the launcher's 30 fps profile) with setFrameRate(FIXED_SOURCE, change always) once, later swapchains only if seamless (never a mode switch during play); the swapchain is FIFO instead of MAILBOX when the cap is at most the panel's rate as reported (DisplayManager, read on the activity thread), with minImageCount images (at least 3), a 100 ms acquire timeout, and the host's pacing 1/32 short of the period so the vsync is the one strict pacer (vk19.63c); a rate reported below the cap later for two windows in a row (dm-stats, once a window) puts the swapchain back to MAILBOX. Off: no panel query at all

name: DM_VK_PREWARM
meaning: Android: `0` skips the pipeline pre-warm screen before the game starts (pipelines of earlier runs made again from pipeline_keys.bin); on by default

name: DM_VK_PREWARM_KEEP
meaning: Android: `1` makes the shader pre-warm keep every pipeline alive (RSS +~500 MB in FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE). Default 0 since vk19.13: each is destroyed right after it is made (only the driver's pipeline cache stays warm) and made again from that cache at its first use

name: DM_VK_REC_THREAD
meaning: Android: `1` (opt-in) queues QueueSubmitCommands and QueuePresentTexture (handles copied) and replays them in order on a record thread, so the Vulkan translation leaves the game's RHI thread; at most 48 submissions and 2 presents queued; QueueFinish and the graphics suspend drain it first

name: DM_VK_REUP_CAP_MB
meaning: Android: while memory is low, re-uploads of written textures wait once a submission has this many MB of uploads (default 16; 0 no cap); first uploads never wait

name: DM_VK_REUP_FRAMES_LOW
meaning: Android: while memory is low, a texture is re-uploaded at most every this many frames (default 4); otherwise at most once a frame

name: DM_VK_REUP_PARTIAL
meaning: Android: `1` (default) re-uploads only the mip levels written since the last upload; `0` re-uploads the whole texture as before

name: DM_VK_RING_CACHED
meaning: Android: `1` puts the host-visible rings in a HOST_CACHED coherent memory type where the GPU has one (the CPU reads them back: dispatch snapshots, write-back compares); default 0, the first coherent type (uncached on the Adreno)

name: DM_VK_RING_CAP_MB
meaning: Android: all submission contexts' own rings together (MB, default 96; was 160). Past it a ring does not grow and a submission that outgrows it takes extra rings, freed when it is done

name: DM_VK_RING_KEEP
meaning: Android: `1` keeps each ring at its size after a quiet stretch (halved only while memory is low); default 0 halves it as before (growing again later maps fresh pages)

name: DM_VK_RING_REUSE
meaning: Android (Harvest Moon heavy scene, H0.5; off by default): `1` keeps ring memory across frames instead of fresh vkAllocateMemory / vkFreeMemory every frame: ctx_pick takes the most recently freed context (completion work done first); ring_fit grows a hot context's ring to the largest power of two under the cap, counting only bytes above each context's RING_MIN, and contexts unused for 300 submissions go back to RING_MIN; the keep pool holds up to 32 extra rings (DM_VK_XRING_KEEP_MB defaults to 256 with it); a submission's first extra ring is sized from the recent overflow (x1.25, 32 MB steps). Kept rings and rings above RING_MIN are let go only when MemAvailable is under DM_VK_MEM_LOW_MB (or the budget is passed), not on an early trim's burst. Nothing changes in what is copied or bound. Per-600 line 'vk: DM_VK_RING_REUSE over the last 600 frames'

name: DM_VK_RTDUMP
meaning: Android: `=<frame>[,<frames>]` writes every render target of that frame (and the next ones) as raw files into DM_VK_SHOT_DIR

name: DM_VK_RTDUMP_DEC
meaning: Android: with DM_VK_RTDUMP, also writes the textures decoded from BC4-7 on upload

name: DM_VK_RT_HOLD
meaning: Android: `0` turns the SetRenderTargets detour hold off: every SetRenderTargets ends the open pass

name: DM_VK_RT_SPLIT
meaning: Android: `0` leaves out vk19.4's split: a held pass is not ended for a draw that samples one of its attachments (the castle wall's contact shadow flickers again)

name: DM_VK_SEG_CACHE
meaning: Android: `1` (default) takes a 4 KB driver segment built earlier in the submission while the stage's texture, sampler, image and storage-buffer bindings are unchanged; `0` builds it for every set

name: DM_VK_SHADOW
meaning: Android (vk19.59): `1` hashes the bytes of every copy_in miss and index scan and counts those an earlier copy of the same range already had (same submission, another submission of the frame, an earlier frame): an estimate of a persistent cache's reach (a direct-mapped table of 64K entries, exact address and length only), logged per 600 frames ('vk: DM_VK_SHADOW per frame …'). Costs the hashing (its ms are in the line). On the run-time list: `set DM_VK_SHADOW 1` in DM_VK_CTL_FILE

name: DM_VK_SHOTS
meaning: Android: `=<frame>,…` writes the presented image of those frames into DM_VK_SHOT_DIR

name: DM_VK_SHOT_DIR
meaning: Android: where DM_VK_SHOTS and DM_VK_RTDUMP write (default: the current folder)

name: DM_VK_SKIP
meaning: Android: `=<mask>` leaves out kinds of GPU work (1 buffer→texture, 2 texture→texture, 4 texture→buffer, 8 clears, 16 uploads, 32 draws / dispatches), for bisecting a wrong picture

name: DM_VK_STAGE_REUSE
meaning: Android: `1` (default) binds a stage's last descriptor set again without resolving its bindings while its shader, texture / sampler / image / storage-buffer bindings, the registrations and the submission are unchanged (only dynamic uniform offsets resolved again); `0` resolves every set

name: DM_VK_STALE_PATCH
meaning: Android: `0` leaves out vk19.3's stale-read patch: a read of an earlier submission's GPU-written range takes its bytes as they are, without the CPU's later rewrites; `2` puts the rewrites in place with one compute dispatch per patched range instead of a copy region per run; default `2` from vk19.44 (checked exact), `1` the copy regions

name: DM_VK_STATE_SKIP
meaning: Android: `1` (default) takes the last draw's pipeline when its key is the same and leaves out a pipeline bind or dynamic state (viewport, scissor, depth bias, blend constants, stencil) equal to what the command buffer has; `0` records all for every draw; from vk19.44 also vertex buffers bound in runs and only when changed, the ring bound once as the index buffer (firstIndex), descriptor sets left bound when unchanged

name: DM_VK_STORE_NONE
meaning: Android: `1` (opt-in, dynamic rendering) records each pass into a secondary command buffer and begins it at the pass's end with STORE for the attachments the pass wrote and STORE_OP_NONE for the rest (loads unchanged)

name: DM_VK_TEXCOUNT
meaning: Android: set, every 600 presents logs the live textures by kind and how many share their storage start with an older one

name: DM_VK_TEXEL_STORE
meaning: Android (vk19.70; per game since merge-main: the default is the game profile's range_store key (`texel`: FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE; off for every other game), the variable overrides it both ways, and the start logs 'vk: DM_VK_TEXEL_STORE=<n> (profile: range_store | env | default off: …)'; on for FFR from vk19.73, session 4: verify 0 differences, recording −0.6…−0.9 and RHIThread −0.6…−0.8 ms at matched clocks; `0` turns it off; read at start; refused with DM_VK_ZEROCOPY): `1` (the profile default where range_store has `texel`) serves uniform texel buffers whose bytes stayed the same over two consecutive frames (page-aligned span hashed on its second miss) from a persistent store with long-lived views, valid while nvn_dirty sees no write to their pages since the stamp (stamp, protect, read; the pool's registration id checked first); a range written three times is refused for 10 s; dropped whole under memory pressure (pages unprotected). `2` also compares guest memory with a host copy at every use and counts differences. One line per 600 frames ('vk: DM_VK_TEXEL_STORE=…')

name: DM_VK_TEXEL_STORE_MB
meaning: Android (vk19.70): the texel store's size in MB (default 32, at most 256), allocated at its first use only

name: DM_VK_TEXLOG
meaning: Android: `<n>` logs the first n textures made (size, format, layout)

name: DM_VK_TRIM_STEADY_S
meaning: Android: while memory stays low without falling, the backend trims again only after this many seconds (default 60; 5 as before); rings go back to their minimum and malloc is purged only under real pressure

name: DM_VK_UBWC
meaning: Android: `2` (opt-in) keeps compression only for render targets nothing is uploaded into; `1` makes images whose views never reinterpret the format keep the GPU's compression: a format list (own format and its sRGB / UNORM twin) or not mutable at all; storage images unchanged. Default 0; keep it off: with it on, texture streaming into compressed images ate untracked driver memory and the low-memory killer ended FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE 4 times in 4

name: DM_VK_VTXIDX_FIX
meaning: Android: `0` leaves out vk19.10's VertexIndex bias (vertex shaders that read VertexIndex get the draw's first copied vertex added back through a push constant)

name: DM_VK_WB_PREP
meaning: Android (off by default, Harvest Moon's profile sets it; hm-fix-2): `1` makes the write-protected guest pages a completion write-back writes writable first through the host pre-write hook (one mprotect per run of pages) instead of a page fault per page on dm-complete (outdoors 324 a frame); a dispatch's changed words prepare only the pages they land in

name: DM_VK_XRING_KEEP_MB
meaning: Android: extra rings kept for reuse (MB, default 64, at most 8 rings; was 32 MB / 4; with DM_VK_RING_REUSE default 256, at most 32 rings); let go under real memory pressure and by the trims

name: DM_VK_ZEROCOPY
meaning: Android: `1` (opt-in, stage Z0) backs CPU-visible memory pools of 64 KB to 256 MB with AHardwareBuffers mapped over their own addresses and imported into Vulkan; vertex and index streams in them are bound where they are (no ring copy) unless a dispatch or a command-list write of the generation touched them

name: DM_VK_ZEROCOPY_MB
meaning: Android: the most pool memory DM_VK_ZEROCOPY backs (MB, default 384; dmabuf memory is not swappable)

name: DM_VSYNC_HZ
meaning: `=<Hz>`: rate at which a host thread fires the vi vsync event when the display link does not drive it (default 60)

name: DM_WAKE_AFTER_G
meaning: vk19.68; on by default on Android from vk19.71 (off on the Mac until measured there) (session 3 at matched clocks: G waited 2.6–3.5 -> 0.35–0.53 ms a frame, all threads −2…−3 ms, pacing unchanged; `0` turns it off): a guest thread's wakes (lock hand-offs, signals) are queued while it holds the host's kernel lock G and signalled right after it releases G, or under G just before it waits with G, instead of while holding it (the woken thread no longer blocks again on G, and G is not held across a wake that can preempt its holder); threads freed meanwhile are kept until no queued wake is outstanding. Counts in the guest-sync line (wakes deferred, sent under G; freed threads kept)

name: DM_WATCH
meaning: `=<s>` dumps all threads after that many seconds (SIGALRM) and turns on the stall watchdog; off unless set

name: DM_WATCH_SAMPLE
meaning: `=<path>` (Mac): when the stall watchdog fires, samples the process for 1 s with `/usr/bin/sample` and writes the thread stacks to that path

name: DM_WATCH_STALL
meaning: `=<s>`: when the frame loop makes no progress for that long (default 15 with `DM_WATCH`), logs a red line, dumps the threads and exits

name: DM_WINDOW
meaning: When set (to any value, `0` included) opens a Mac window with keyboard and controller input; unset runs headless with the guest on the current thread; the Mac launcher sets it

name: DM_WINDOW_TOP
meaning: `1` (Mac, with `DM_WINDOW`) orders the game window in front without activating it and keeps it above other apps' windows, so a covered window does not slow the run; `regress.py` sets it

name: DM_XCODE_DERIVED_DATA
meaning: Xcode derived data folder for `build_ipa.sh` (default `$W/build/ios/xcode-dd`); the NSP script points it into the game's build folder

name: DM_XCODE_PROJECT_DIR
meaning: Folder of the per-game Xcode project that `build_ipa.sh --prepare-xcode` makes (default `$W/xcode`); the NSP script sets it

name: DM_XV_FILE
meaning: File where the attachment validity ledger keeps the keys it disabled after a violation, read at the next launch

name: DM_YIELD_BACKOFF
meaning: `0` turns off the yield back-off; `=<cap µs>[:<start µs>]` sets its sleep cap and the run of yields after which it starts (default 250:2000)
